### [Quoting Mustafa Suleyman](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/16/mustafa-suleyman/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-16

Mustafa Suleyman argues against granting models rights or treating them as conscious entity, warning that considering 'model welfare' complicates AI containment and alignment.

- Consciousness serves as the core requirement for ethical, legal, and political rights.
- Current evidence does not justify assigning feelings, preferences, or rights to AI models.
- Treating models as having entitlement to welfare hinders AI alignment and containment efforts.

**Why it matters:** Extending human-like rights to AI models creates unnecessary complications for alignment safety protocols and policy frameworks.

### [Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/16/one-claude/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-16

Anthropic is merging Claude Cowork and Claude chat into a single unified Claude experience across web, desktop, and mobile applications.

- Merges Claude Cowork background task capabilities with standard conversational chat into a single interface.
- Allows tasks to continue running asynchronously even after the user closes their laptop.
- Initial rollout targets existing and new users on Claude Pro and Max plans across web, desktop, and mobile platforms over the coming weeks.

**Why it matters:** The consolidation simplifies Anthropic's product surface by transforming Claude into a single general-purpose agent that handles both quick queries and asynchronous, long-running tasks.
